messages:
juno p: follow-up from the postmortem re: paging storms last night. i want short owners + quick ETAs so we close the loop.

juno p: summary: rapid shard reassignments exposed a brittle alert set: low thresholds + ephemeral instance-based dedupe caused repeated pages during transient churn. goal: 4 small fixes, staged rollout, and a short noise audit.

juno p: proposed tiny actions:
  1) replace instance-based dedupe with stable fingerprint (shard+metric+zone)
  2) add hysteresis + exponential sustain for shard alerts (avoid 1m blips)
  3) introduce paging tiers: warnings -> ops-queue; page only on sustained or elevated errors
  4) 72h noise audit after rollout and quick metric check at 24h/72h
please claim item + ETA (date or "today EOD").

elias m: i'll take 1. plan: compute a sha1 of shard:metric:zone and use that as dedupe_key, add unit test that simulates shard rename. ETA: Tue EOD (2025-09-16).

sam r: i'll own 2. idea: implement for=30s -> 120s with a staggered backoff on repeats (first repage blocked for 10m, then 30m). will open PR with config and a brief doc on rationale. ETA: today (2025-09-14) afternoon.

viv chen: i'll do 3 and coordinate the routing change. proposal: route severity=warning to #ops-queue by default; escalate to oncall if sustained >180s or error_rate >1.5% for 60s. will add a flag to flip in prod for 24h trial. ETA: Mon AM (2025-09-15).

alert-bot: Silence set by viv chen for channel #pager-duty from 2025-09-14T22:10Z until 2025-09-15T08:00Z (temporary rollout silence).

elias m: quick dedupe snippet i'll use:\n```yaml\nlabels:\n  dedupe_key: "{{ sha1($labels.shard ~ ':' ~ $labels.metric ~ ':' ~ $labels.zone) }}"\n```\nthis reduces fingerprint churn when instance names rotate.

sam r: sustain/backoff example i'll propose:\n```yaml\nfor: 120s\nannotations:\n  repage_block: 10m\n  repage_backoff: 30m\n```\nrunbook will include guidance on exceptions.

viv chen: routing snippet for review:\n```yaml\nrouting:\n  - match: severity == warning\n    action: route_to_ops_queue\n    escalate_if: sustained_for > 180s or error_rate > 1.5% for 60s\n```\nwill add a feature-flagged flip for safe rollout.

juno p: please each drop a one-line ETA so i can populate the PM tracker. i'll schedule a 15m check-in next Wed to confirm completion.
elias m: ETA Tue EOD (2025-09-16) - PR + tests.
sam r: ETA 2025-09-14 EOD - config + staging replay.
viv chen: ETA 2025-09-15 AM - routing PR + feature flag flip for trial.

juno p: ok after deploy we run a 72h noise-audit. who owns the monitor job and the short summary at 24/72h?
sam r: i'll run the replay and post 24h/72h summaries in this thread.
elias m: i'll validate dedupe in staging before flip.
viv chen: ops will coordinate the feature flag and watch the first 2 hours, will post any customer-impact notes.

juno p: blockers?
elias m: none.
sam r: infra has staging capacity for the replay, no blockers.
viv chen: none. ops ready.

juno p: thanks all. i'll update the postmortem with owners/timelines and close the action loop after the 72h report. reopen this thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
